sections.heading: Todoist just lost your tasks again. Get them back in 30 seconds.
sections.text: ⚠ REAL, DOCUMENTED DATA-LOSS PATTERN Todoist just lost your tasks again. Get them back in 30 seconds. A backup and restore layer for Todoist and Asana. Runs on your machine, uses your own API token, and never sends your task data anywhere. Git does the version history. You just get your tasks back. Get lifetime access, $29 See how it works ↓ ● Your token never leaves your machine ● Open source, audit it yourself ● Not affiliated with Doist or Asana, Inc.

sections.heading: Three commands. No account, no server, no exceptions.
sections.text: HOW IT WORKS Three commands. No account, no server, no exceptions. Every step runs locally or in your own free GitHub Actions job. Nothing routes through infrastructure anyone else operates. Connect your own token Generate a personal API token from Todoist or Asana's own settings. It's stored in your Keychain, never sent to us, because there's no "us" in the data path. Automatic snapshots A scheduled job pulls your task list and commits it to a git repo you control. Git's own history is the diff engine, nothing custom to trust. Restore what's missing One command diffs any past snapshot against

sections.heading: Before you ask
sections.text: FAQ Before you ask Do you ever see my tasks? No. The tool runs on your machine or your own GitHub Actions job, using a token only you hold. There is no server we operate that your data passes through. Is this affiliated with Todoist or Asana? No. UnDeleted is an independent third-party tool built on their public APIs, not created by, affiliated with, or supported by Doist or Asana, Inc. What if I lose tasks it can't restore? Restore only recreates tasks that exist in a past snapshot. If something was deleted before your first snapshot ran, there's nothing to restore from: set it up before you
